ce_bugs.text: Stored XSS via unsanitized imported HTML: cook_method raw_html bypasses the Markdown/Sanitize pipeline, and remote/RSS content with scripts is rendered with raw in embed view
Protocol-relative URLs (starting with //) are incorrectly matched by href.start_with?('/') in absolutize_urls, producing broken URLs
TopicEmbed.import crashes with NoMethodError when embed.post is nil because there is no dependent-destroy/cleanup of topic_embeds rows
Loading view reload loop never terminates on failure, causing unbounded re-enqueuing of RetrieveTopic and synchronous PollFeed runs driven by visitor traffic
topic_id_for_embed doesn't verify the topic exists, so a stale topic_embeds row causes a 500 on the embed endpoint
Race window between throttle check and import allows two concurrent retrieves to both create posts, with the second violating the unique embed_url index and raising
disqus.thor loses the --category option handling, breaking existing invocations with -c

perform_retrieve calls full feed re-parse and TopicEmbed.import for every embed request when feed_polling_enabled, causing material-resource amplification from unauthenticated embed traffic with no limit on feed size or item count
import_remote uses open(url).read with no size cap, allowing unbounded download into memory that is then re-parsed twice by Readability and absolutize_urls

Embed loading page uses a 30-second fixed-interval reload loop with no cap; failed retrievals leave embeds in a permanent reload loop generating sustained traffic since the Redis throttle only gates the job not the request path

embed.js origin check using discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) is trivially bypassable — empty e.origin passes the check (indexOf('') === 0), and substring matching accepts any origin appearing anywhere in discourseUrl rather than exact origin comparison

embed.html.erb postMessage uses request.referer as targetOrigin, which is nil when iframe is loaded directly, rendering an empty string literal that causes postMessage to throw SyntaxError so the resize message is never delivered
TopicEmbed.import from PollFeed inserts raw RSS item content with cook_method: raw_html, bypassing all sanitization and enabling stored XSS if the feed is compromised or publishes untrusted content
disqus.thor removed the public --category/-c CLI option without deprecation, breaking existing scripts and causing imports to land uncategorized

topic_embed.rb update path assumes embed.post still exists — if the post was deleted (no cascade/FK), PostRevisor.new(nil).revise! raises NoMethodError, permanently wedging re-import and 500ing the embed endpoint

No timeout on remote fetches using Kernel#open with no options in topic_embed.rb import_remote, poll_feed.rb, and disqus.thor, which blocks indefinitely on slow/hung remote hosts and can pin Sidekiq worker threads

PollFeed job has retry: false and no error handling; a single bad feed item (nil content or title causing NoMethodError) aborts the whole feed and silently skips all subsequent items every hour with no notification
Throttle key is set via Redis setnx in retrieved_recently? before perform_retrieve runs, so failed retrieves lock out retry attempts for 60s and the user sees 'Loading Discussion...' indefinitely
Protocol-relative URLs like src="//cdn.example.com/x.jpg" are mangled by start_with?('/') into http://host//cdn... — a real correctness bug
Stored XSS via unsanitized external HTML: remote feed content marked raw_html skips cooking/sanitization and is rendered with raw in embed/best.html.erb
Weak origin check in postMessage handler: discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) substring match allows malicious origins to pass
Race on concurrent embed creation: TopicEmbed.create! inside transaction can raise uncaught ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique with unique index on embed_url
postMessage targetOrigin from client-controlled request.referer: nil referer causes postMessage to throw, and trusting referer is fragile
Feed item fields assumed present: nil content or title in RSS/Atom items raises NoMethodError aborting entire feed processing with no per-item error isolation
Duplicated attribute-rewriting loops in absolutize_urls for a[href] and img[src], also missing protocol-relative URLs
force: true was retroactively added to the already-shipped create_top_topics migration, causing potential data loss on re-run and schema drift between environments

topic_embeds foreign keys (topic_id/post_id) are plain integers with no FK constraints or indexes, leaving orphaned embed rows that crash TopicEmbed.import with NoMethodError when the post is deleted, stalling the PollFeed job
Stored XSS: PollFeed passes unfiltered RSS/Atom content HTML into TopicEmbed.import with cook_method raw_html, which is rendered unsanitized via raw post.cooked
cook_method raw_html in Post#cook bypasses the entire post-cook safety pipeline including sanitization, filters, and onebox handling
Referer-based access control in EmbedController is trivially spoofable, allowing attackers to trigger retrieve_topic jobs and force scraping of arbitrary URLs on the embeddable host

Feed polling job has no error handling and retry: false — a timeout, missing content, or nil link kills the job silently and the feed is never polled again, with one bad item aborting all subsequent items
Non-atomic redis throttle (setnx followed by expire) in TopicRetriever can leave a retrieved:<url> key with no TTL, permanently locking out that embed URL
Nil-post/deleted-topic cascades: PostRevisor called with nil post raises NoMethodError, and stale topic_id from TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed causes TopicView failures with no cleanup path
Client-side postMessage origin check uses indexOf substring match instead of prefix/URL-parse comparison, allowing spoofed origins to pass
loading.html.erb reload loop has no failure signal — failed RetrieveTopic jobs cause the browser to reload every 30 seconds forever, re-enqueuing jobs unboundedly
RSS import path never applies the whitelist used in import_remote, and javascript: URLs in href are not filtered, allowing javascript: links to survive rendering

mrv_findings.text: poll_feed.rb:36: `i.content` is nil on standard RSS 2.0 feeds (which use `<description>`), causing NoMethodError and crashing the entire poll; with retry: false the feed import never works for RSS feeds
poll_feed.rb:36: `String#scrub` requires Ruby 2.1 but this 2013-era codebase targets Ruby 1.9/2.0 where scrub does not exist, so NoMethodError kills the job even when content is present

topic_embed.rb:50: `open(url)` used without `require 'open-uri'`; if open-uri isn't already loaded, Kernel#open treats the URI as a filename and raises NoMethodError/ArgumentError, making TopicEmbed.import_remote fail intermittently depending on load order

poll_feed_spec.rb:2: spec uses fabricated/unrelated require `require_dependency 'jobs/regular/process_post'` instead of requiring the actual job under test (PollFeed), potentially causing LoadError or masking the intended require

embed_controller.rb:13: synchronous execution of Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({}) inside the backgrounded retrieve_topic job runs full feed parse plus article fetch inline; the 60-second throttle (retrieved_recently? / 1-minute cache) means the user's reload after the 30-second JS timer likely still hits the throttle path and shows the loading page indefinitely, so first-time embeds frequently never render

Embedded HTML imported via TopicEmbed.import is rendered with no sanitization: RSS feed content and Disqus readability content bypass the cook pipeline (cook_method: raw_html) and are rendered with raw post.cooked, allowing script/link injection (e.g., javascript: URLs in href/src)
Origin check in embed.js uses indexOf substring match instead of exact match, and lacks any spec/test, so origins that are substrings of discourseUrl can send resize messages
No error state for retrieval failure: loading view reloads every 30 seconds forever if TopicRetriever fails (host mismatch, missing user, no content found), causing an infinite reload loop
PollFeed job has no error handling per feed item or fetch: nil content/title or a failed open() raises and with retry: false a single malformed item permanently kills the hourly poll

TopicEmbed.import failure case unhandled for blank title/user: PostCreator returns an invalid unsaved Post so post.present? is true, TopicEmbed.create! references nil post.id violating DB constraint, raising uncaught inside the transaction
Embed view does not handle topic_id_for_embed returning deleted or restricted/private category topics; TopicView may raise or expose private-category posts to anonymous embed viewers
Iframe height only communicated on window.onload; late-loading images/avatars from other hosts leave iframe with stale/short height with no dynamic re-resize
feed_key (feed-modified:<sha1> cache key) is defined but never used, so conditional GET/ETag skip-polling was dropped and every feed is fully re-fetched and re-processed hourly
Adding force: true to the already-run create_top_topics migration can drop and recreate existing top_topics data and silently changes behavior across all environments
Whitespace-only edits to migrate_word_counts.rb add unrelated diff noise and pollute history/blame
Removal of the --category CLI option from the disqus task causes a hard crash for existing users running disqus import --category X
Removing category_id logic and the PostCreator call means imported topics no longer respect category or contain the [Permalink] body content
The skip_validations option added to PostRevisor is a general validation bypass not restricted to embed imports, allowing any caller to silently bypass post validations

TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve invokes Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({}) synchronously, repurposing a scheduled job as an on-demand library call and re-parsing the entire feed inline on every /embed/best miss
The feed_key ('feed-modified:...') is defined but never used anywhere, leaving dead code that will silently rot

TOCTOU check-then-insert race on embed_url in topic_embed.rb: TopicEmbed.where then create! is not atomic, concurrent retrievals both see embed blank and unique index makes second create! raise inside Topic.transaction, leaving orphaned side-effect jobs referencing rolled back post/topic ids that retry and loop

topic_retriever.rb synchronously executes the entire feed poll (Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})) for a single-URL retrieval, causing a boundary/ownership inversion that imports every feed item, creates the race, can create dozens of topics, and blocks the Sidekiq worker with no timeout on the open() calls

poll_feed.rb poison-item cascading failure with no per-item isolation and sidekiq_options retry: false: CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) raises NoMethodError when a feed item lacks content, aborting the whole each loop so all subsequent items are never imported and the feed is permanently stuck

raw_html cook path (return raw) bypasses the cooking pipeline including after_post_cook filters and sanitization, and the embed view renders it with raw post.cooked, allowing javascript:/data-URI hrefs from third-party feed content to be injected verbatim into all embedding pages

feed_key (SHA1 of feed_polling_url) is computed and memoized but never used — no conditional fetch or dedup cache — so polling cost grows linearly with feed size, dead code signaling an unwired throttle

cook_method discriminator is a bare int with default 1 hardcoded in the migration while the mapping is a positional Enum in Post.cook_methods; reordering or inserting a symbol silently changes meaning of existing rows with no migration or error

topic_embeds table has no foreign keys or unique indexes on topic_id/post_id, permitting duplicate or cross-topic embeds and orphaned rows after Topic/Post deletion, causing EmbedController#best to construct TopicView for a nonexistent topic

loading page reloads every 30s forever with no terminal state: if RetrieveTopic fails the embedded widget shows 'Loading Discussion...' indefinitely with no error path to the visitor and no cap on the reload loop

The --category CLI option (method_option :category, aliases: '-c') in lib/tasks/disqus.thor:117 was silently deleted, breaking existing import invocations using -c and causing topics to import uncategorized
The created_at of Disqus threads is dropped because TopicEmbed.import_remote doesn't accept a created_at, so imported topics get today's date instead of the source date
db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 was edited to add force: true to create_table :top_topics, which drops existing table data on environments where the migration already ran
Unrelated churn sneaking into the PR: whitespace edit to 20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb and removed blank line in post_revisor.rb:14

cook in app/models/post.rb:127-131 short-circuits with 'return raw if cook_method == raw_html' before Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook), so plugins relying on after_post_cook silently stop applying to imported RSS/readability posts
Stored XSS via raw_html cook method returning unsanitized HTML rendered with raw, since RSS feed content from PollFeed is imported with no sanitization
HTML injection via user-influenced embed URL interpolated into single-quoted HTML attributes in topic_embed.rb, with only a weak http(s) prefix regex check
Referer-based access control on /embed/best with X-Frame-Options ALLOWALL allows trivially spoofed access to private topic content with no auth

TopicRetriever spec mocks perform_retrieve in both success tests, leaving the Redis throttle (setnx/expire), no_throttle bypass, embed-exists check, PollFeed invocation, and fetch_http user lookup completely untested

EmbedController specs assert only response.should_not be_success, so they pass on any unrelated 500 and never verify the intended Discourse::InvalidAccess/400 semantics, allowing the referer-host security check to regress undetected
EmbedController tests stub TopicView and retrieval entirely, so best.html.erb, the layout's postMessage height script, and the @topic_view.posts.present? branches have zero rendering coverage
PollFeed specs stub out poll_feed itself, leaving the URL fallback, CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub), user.blank? return, and TopicEmbed.import call untested; feed_key is dead/untested code
TopicEmbed 'Supports updating the post' test only asserts cooked content, never verifying content_sha1 update, no duplicate topics, or skipping revisions for unchanged content
absolutize_urls non-standard-port branch (uri.port != 80 && != 443) is never exercised, and import_remote/readability extraction has zero tests
PostRevisor change @post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations]) has no test for invalid raw under skip_validations: true or default validation behavior
raw_html cook short-circuit and cook_method assignment lack unit tests asserting Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook) is actually bypassed
force: true added to already-applied migration create_top_topics.rb can silently DROP TABLE IF EXISTS top_topics, destroying aggregate data when schema is rebuilt or db:migrate:redo runs
Editing the existing top_topics migration causes schema drift: migration file no longer matches what was actually run in existing databases
force: true on new topic_embeds table in create_topic_embeds.rb can silently drop a pre-existing table and its rows, then recreate it empty
Dropping and recreating topic_embeds orphans previously imported topics, causing TopicEmbed.import to create duplicate topics for the same embed URLs
topic_embeds table has no foreign key constraints or ON DELETE behavior for topic_id/post_id, leaving no cleanup path for orphaned references when topics/posts are deleted
Deleted topics leave dangling topic_embeds rows, causing EmbedController#best to construct a TopicView for a nonexistent topic on every request
